title: [master] Overdue Balance (LCY) filters do not behave as expected if you open the Customer Card from a document or journal.
summary: The Customer Card now applies a default date filter in the OnAfterGetCurrRecord function to ensure the Overdue Balance (LCY) calculation displays the correct overdue amount and drill-down filters work properly when opened from documents or journals.
key_points: Date filter now defaults to 0D..WorkDate() in OnAfterGetCurrRecord, not just OnOpenPage
Overdue Balance (LCY) now shows the correct overdue amount instead of total balance when opening the card from documents or journals
Drill-down filters on the overdue balance now correctly include the due-date filter regardless of how the card is opened
Aligns the Customer Card behavior with the Vendor Card logic
Fix applied across all localization layers (APAC, BE, ES, FR, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU, W1)
quote: Also default Date Filter to 0D..WorkDate() in the card's OnAfterGetCurrRecordFunc (mirroring the Vendor Card)
